name: Raptor
tagline: Full-flow staged combustion — the hardest cycle, finally flying
description: The Raptor is the first full-flow staged-combustion engine to reach operational flight. In this thermodynamic cycle, both propellants — LOX and liquid methane — pass through preburners before entering the main combustion chamber, extracting maximum energy and leaving virtually no unburned propellant. Engineers had studied the concept for decades and concluded it was prohibitively complex; SpaceX built it anyway. Thirty-three Raptors ignite simultaneously on Super Heavy's first stage, and a vacuum-optimised variant powers Starship's upper stage. The first integrated Starship flight carrying Raptors lifted off on 20 April 2023.
best_known_for: First full-flow staged-combustion engine to fly — 33 lift Super Heavy
